title: Unify bounded commit subjects and exact canonical Task-ID validation

supersedes_review.note: Addressed the recorded P1 text-based closeout identity waiver and P2 implicit GITHUB_WORKSPACE/proc-parent module discovery. The owner was subsequently assigned to Codex with Antigravity as canonical reviewer; no approval is claimed.

owned: two deterministic bounded-commit-subject-prefix helpers (canonical_commit_subject_prefix, commit_subject_prefix_variants) shared by CI, the worker commit wrapper, and canonical done
single authoritative checker (check_commit_trailers.check_message) across CI, worker_commit preflight, and ai_status done/reconciliation

exact prefix comparison before first colon against shared prefix variants across all consumers, rejecting short-ID suffix collisions (e.g. ABC-001-OTHER:, ABC-0010:) and bounded long-prefix suffix collisions
rejection of duplicate trailers (both conflicting values and identical duplicate occurrences) in check_commit_trailers, worker_commit, and ai_status
removal of text-only merge exemptions in check_message; unproven raw message strings without Task-ID trailer are rejected
worker_commit preflight unconditionally validates commit identity via check_message respecting PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT with no target-cwd override and no fail-open fallback
ai_status lazily imports check_commit_trailers so that non-commit status commands execute cleanly in sparse command environments
test fixture synchronization across test_index_safety.py and test_git_workflow_helpers.py matching the single checker contract without production workarounds
Every selected authored closeout message uses the shared checker and audited owner/reviewer validation; no text-based trailer waiver remains.
Explicit command-root or target-only module resolution; no parent-process or GITHUB_WORKSPACE discovery.
not_changing: approved_closeout_commit_ref / approved_closeout_metadata_ref merge-first-parent unwrapping and ancestry verification
auto_integrator.py, worker_runner.py, supervisor.py, branch protection, credentials, or canonical JSON shape
validate_merged_tooling_done's Human/Ops + development_tooling authority and its reviewer-free direct-tooling exception
real git merge commit skipping in git rev-list via parent count (>1)
composes_with: the existing per-task PR review/merge flow used to recover PR #5639's own original approval

failure_reproduction.case: On dev 46bbfe935df1e68740569fb5dc6233897de98b0b, check_commit_trailers.check_message required subjects <=72 chars while ai_status.py's done-finalize gate required the literal, untruncated task id to appear in the subject. A 92-char generated task id (INTEGRATION-UNBLOCK-GOV-APPROVAL-AUTHORITY-PREREQUISITE-001-MERGE-STATE-BLOCKED-B14932FE23E9) cannot satisfy both: its genuine, independently-approved, merged (PR #5639, head 50adbe0c68cfcc5d42024061c91f86dedb45159c into c607359338026f4e440f62d052e19648d78d3f04) commit passed CI's bounded-subject check but could never satisfy done's literal-substring check.

codex_reopen_5ade9528b_finding_and_fix.finding: P1 scripts/ai_status.py:3472 still used subject.startswith((task_id, full_prefix, bounded_prefix)). With Task-ID: ABC-001, subjects ABC-001-OTHER: repair and ABC-0010: repair were rejected by CI and worker preflight but accepted by collect_done_delivery_metadata.
codex_reopen_5ade9528b_finding_and_fix.fix: Converged collect_done_delivery_metadata and validate_merged_tooling_done on the single checker.check_message, which extracts the exact subject prefix before the first colon and checks actual_prefix in (target_task_id, full_prefix, bounded_prefix). Added tests for short-ID suffix collisions and identical duplicate trailers across all consumers.
codex_reopen_5ade9528b_finding_and_fix.reproducer_probe: /tmp/ops-commit-identity-001-codex-review-probe.py verified: ABC-001-OTHER: and ABC-0010: rejected identically across CI, worker preflight, and closeout; positive PR #5639 commit 50adbe0c accepted identically across all three paths.

failure_reproduction.positive_case_unaffected: The immutable, already-merged PR #5639 commit (50adbe0c68cfcc5d42024061c91f86dedb45159c, real 92-char Task-ID, subject 'INTEGRATION-UNBLOCK-GOV-APPROVAL-AU: record accepted source merge') passes CI, worker preflight, and owner metadata collection unchanged.

codex_reopen_8cdd72d_finding_and_fix.finding: Closeout waived required trailers and actor/reviewer checks for Merge/Revert/promote/hotfix/publish text; worker loaded missing modules from parent cwd or GITHUB_WORKSPACE.
codex_reopen_8cdd72d_finding_and_fix.fix: Removed waiver and discovery; added 35 closeout style/metadata subcases plus missing-local-module and incomplete-explicit-runtime regressions. Structural merge selection and audited reassignment implementations unchanged.

implementation.shared_helpers: common.canonical_commit_subject_prefix(task_id, max_len=72) deterministic compacted prefix; common.commit_subject_prefix_variants(task_id, max_len=72) returns (full_prefix, bounded_prefix).
implementation.ci_check_commit_trailers: check_message is the sole validator. Compares prefix before colon against commit_subject_prefix_variants, rejects identical or conflicting duplicate trailers, supports --task-id, and rejects unproven merge strings without Task-ID trailer.
implementation.worker_commit_preflight: Delegates to the one shared check_message; uses the issued command runtime or target repository, with no implicit external module discovery. Missing dependencies fail closed.
implementation.ai_status_done_gate: collect_done_delivery_metadata delegates directly to checker.check_message(full_message, required=required_fields, prefix_required=prefix_required, expected_task_id=task_id, delivery_class='product'). Lazy import via _commit_trailer_checker().
implementation.validate_merged_tooling_done: delegates directly to checker.check_message(commit_message, required=('Task-ID',), prefix_required=True, expected_task_id=task_id, delivery_class='tooling').
implementation.test_fixtures: test_index_safety.py and test_task_review_merge_gate.py provide check_commit_trailers.py in isolated repos and runtime fixtures; test_git_workflow_helpers.py asserts rejection of unproven merge subject strings lacking Task-ID trailer.
